title: 把岸边接起来
short: We can expand the island beside the shore. Keep each new surface close to the old land. A gradual change leaves a short distance for the worker to cross.
text: We can expand the island beside the shore. Keep each new surface close to the old land. A gradual change leaves a short distance for the worker to cross. Start with the nearest section, then connect the next one. The trees can remain where they are. There is no need to clear the whole forest before making a path.
zh: 沿岸逐步扩地，让新地面贴着旧陆地。先连接最近的一块，再接下一块；保留已有树木，不用先清空树林。
question: 这次先接哪一块？
cue: Connect the nearest section first, and leave the trees beside the path.
cue_options: 先接近岸，留住路边树
先接远岸，留住路边树
先接近岸，清掉路边树
sentence: Connect the nearest section to the shore.
sentence_zh: 把最近的一块接到岸边。

title: 第一批木板
short: The sawmill turns short logs into boards. Keep the surface clear and move one log at a time. This is efficient: it can reduce waste and preserve useful pieces.
text: The sawmill turns short logs into boards. Keep the surface clear and move one log at a time. This is efficient: it can reduce waste and preserve useful pieces. Put the finished boards beside the table, away from the moving blade. Later, the boards will form the cottage floor and the narrow path beside the water.
zh: 锯木坊把原木切成木板。台面保持清空，一次送一根木头，减少浪费；成品放在台旁，远离锯片，用于地板和栈道。
question: 木板切好后放哪里？
cue: Place the finished boards beside the table, away from the moving blade.
cue_options: 成品放台旁，远离锯片
成品放台上，靠近锯片
原木放台旁，暂停加工
sentence: Keep the finished boards beside the table.
sentence_zh: 把切好的木板放在台子旁。

title: 石岸上的砖窑
short: Gather stone for the kiln base. The thick walls retain heat, but the front opening must remain clear. Be patient after firing. Avoid moving the bricks while they are hot.
text: Gather stone for the kiln base. The thick walls retain heat, but the front opening must remain clear. Be patient after firing. Avoid moving the bricks while they are hot. Leave a small space between each row so air can pass through. Once the bricks cool, carry them to the new garden wall and the windmill base.
zh: 先收集石料搭窑基。厚墙保温，前面的开口要畅通，砖排之间留空隙。烧好后等砖冷却，再送去花园和风车。
question: 刚烧好的砖应该怎么处理？
cue: Leave the front opening clear, and wait for the bricks to cool.
cue_options: 保持窑口畅通，等砖冷却
封住窑口，等砖冷却
保持窑口畅通，立即搬砖
sentence: Let the bricks cool before moving them.
sentence_zh: 搬动这些砖之前，先让它们冷却。

title: 留一条可以走的路
short: The meadow has room for a garden and a path. Allocate adequate space between them. Our choice matters: the worker must still reach the small hill beyond the garden.
text: The meadow has room for a garden and a path. Allocate adequate space between them. Our choice matters: the worker must still reach the small hill beyond the garden. Put the new beds on one side instead of across the middle. Flowers can grow along the edge, while the open path connects the old shore to the new ground.
zh: 草地要给花园和道路都留出空间。种植床放在一边，不要横断中间的路，让工人能穿过花园到后面的小丘。
question: 种植床怎么摆更合适？
cue: Place the beds on one side, and keep the middle path open.
cue_options: 床靠一边，中间留路
床在中间，两侧留空
床靠一边，中间加床
sentence: Keep a clear path beside the garden.
sentence_zh: 在花园旁边留出一条畅通的路。

title: 石缝里的晶簇
short: Notice the pale crystals in the dark stone. Distinguish the loose pieces from the large cluster. The points are fragile, so preserve the cluster and collect the loose pieces first.
text: Notice the pale crystals in the dark stone. Distinguish the loose pieces from the large cluster. The points are fragile, so preserve the cluster and collect the loose pieces first. A heavy blow could break several points at once. Use a small tool near the base. Leave the tallest crystal as a bright feature of the new bay.
zh: 观察深色岩石里的浅色晶体。先区分松散小块和大晶簇，优先采小块；尖端易碎，用小工具从根部操作，留下最高的一簇。
question: 应该先采哪一部分？
cue: Collect the loose pieces first, and leave the tallest crystal in place.
cue_options: 先采松散小块，保留最高晶簇
先采最高晶簇，留下松散小块
先敲碎整簇，再分拣小块
sentence: Leave the tallest crystal beside the bay.
sentence_zh: 把最高的一簇晶体留在小湾旁。

title: 给新船装上帆
short: Gather boards, strong cloth, and iron parts for the new boat. Fit the boards first, then add the cloth sail. Keep the iron parts in a dry box beside the boat.
text: Gather boards, strong cloth, and iron parts for the new boat. Fit the boards first, then add the cloth sail. Keep the iron parts in a dry box beside the boat. Use them to reinforce the places where the boards meet. Check the bottom for gaps before moving the boat into the water. A careful repair now helps make the boat reliable.
zh: 收集木板、结实的帆布和铁件，先装木板，再装船帆。铁件放在船旁的干燥箱子里，用来加固木板接合处。下水前检查船底的缝隙，认真修补，让船更可靠。
question: 应该先装哪一部分？
cue: Fit the boards first, then add the cloth sail. Keep the iron parts dry.
cue_options: 先装船帆，让铁件保持干燥
先装木板，把铁件暂放水中
先装木板，让铁件保持干燥
sentence: Fit the boards before adding the sail.
sentence_zh: 装船帆之前，先把木板装好。

title: 顺着旗子去群岛
short: We sail to the green islands for hard wood and fruit. Follow the bright flags along the shore. Leave some fruit on each tree so the birds still have food.
text: We sail to the green islands for hard wood and fruit. Follow the bright flags along the shore. Leave some fruit on each tree so the birds still have food. Tie the boat beside the steps before carrying anything aboard. Gather fallen wood near the path, and keep the fruit in a basket away from wet ropes.
zh: 我们去绿色群岛寻找硬木和果实，沿岸跟着明亮的旗子前进。每棵树上留一些果实给鸟吃。搬东西上船前，把船系在台阶旁；收集路边掉落的木头，把果实放进远离湿绳的篮子。
question: 为什么要在每棵树上留一些果实？
cue: Follow the flags along the shore, and leave some fruit for the birds.
cue_options: 沿岸跟着旗子走，把果实全部摘光
沿岸跟着旗子走，留些果实给鸟
沿小路寻找木头，把果实放在船边
sentence: Leave some fruit on each tree for birds.
sentence_zh: 在每棵树上留一些果实给鸟。

title: 把海玻璃磨清亮
short: Collect the pale sea glass beside the rocks. Wash off the sand, then rub each piece until the surface is smooth. Only clear pieces can become lenses for the telescope.
text: Collect the pale sea glass beside the rocks. Wash off the sand, then rub each piece until the surface is smooth. Only clear pieces can become lenses for the telescope. Put cloudy pieces in a separate tray. They can decorate the workshop instead. Hold a finished lens toward the sky and check whether a distant tree looks clear.
zh: 收集岩石旁的浅色海玻璃，先洗掉沙子，再把表面磨光滑。清透的玻璃用于制作望远镜镜片；浑浊的碎片另放一盘，可以装饰工坊。把磨好的镜片举向天空，看看远处的树是否清楚。
question: 哪种海玻璃适合做镜片？
options: 表面仍沾着沙子的碎片
cue: Keep the clear glass for lenses, and put the cloudy pieces in the tray.
cue_options: 清透玻璃做镜片，浑浊碎片放托盘
浑浊玻璃做镜片，清透碎片放托盘
把两种玻璃都留在沙子里
sentence: Wash the glass before making it smooth.
sentence_zh: 把玻璃磨光滑之前，先洗干净。

title: 黑沙岸边的石管
short: The black shore has strong stone that can withstand water. Carry small blocks to the work table. Shape them into short pipes, and smooth the edges before joining the pieces.
text: The black shore has strong stone that can withstand water. Carry small blocks to the work table. Shape them into short pipes, and smooth the edges before joining the pieces. Leave a round opening through each pipe so water can pass. Check the joints for gaps. Keep finished pipes beside the path, ready for the new water station.
zh: 黑沙岸边有耐水的坚硬石料。把小石块搬到工作台，做成短石管，接合前先磨平边缘。每根管子中间留圆孔让水流过，检查接口有没有缝隙，成品放在路边，准备送去引水站。
question: 接合石管之前要做什么？
options: 先把所有短管接成一段
cue: Smooth the edges of each pipe before joining the pieces.
cue_options: 先接合石管，再磨平边缘
先磨平边缘，再搬到花园
先磨平边缘，再接合石管
sentence: Smooth the edges before joining the pipes.
sentence_zh: 接合石管之前，先磨平边缘。

title: 让水流到花园
short: The tide wheel turns as the water moves. Connect the stone pipes before opening the gate. Then follow the water along the channel to check that it reaches the garden.
text: The tide wheel turns as the water moves. Connect the stone pipes before opening the gate. Then follow the water along the channel to check that it reaches the garden. If a joint leaks, close the gate and repair it. Keep leaves away from the wheel. The small pool beside the garden can hold water while the wheel rests.
zh: 水流推动潮轮。先接好石管，再打开闸门，沿水渠看看水是否到达花园。发现接口漏水就先关闸修补。让树叶远离潮轮；花园旁的小池子能在潮轮停下时存水。
question: 打开闸门之前先做什么？
options: 先清空花园旁的小池子
先把成品石管搬回工作台
cue: Close the gate before repairing the pipe, then open it again when the joint is secure.
cue_options: 先开闸放水，再检查管道接口
先关闸修管，接口牢固后再开闸
先关闸修管，修好后保持关闭
sentence: Connect the pipes before opening the gate.
sentence_zh: 打开闸门之前，先接好管道。
